content: मालिन् {%a.%} [माला अस्त्यस्य इनि] .²1 Wearing a garland. .²2 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Crowned or wreathed with, encircled by; समुद्रमालिनी पृथ्वी; so अंशुमालिन्, मरीचिमालिन्, ऊर्मिमालिन् <ab>&c.</ab>; व्यराजतादित्य इवार्चिमाली <ls>Rām. 5. 54. 48</ls>; युवतिषु कोमलमाल्यमालिनीषु <ls>Śi. 7. 61</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A gardener. .²2 A garland-maker, florist. .{@-नी@} .²1 A female florist, the wife of a garland-maker. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the city of Champā. .²3 A girl seven years old representing Durgā at the Durgā festival. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²5 The celestial Ganges. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a metre; see <ls>App.</ls> ननमयययुतेयं मालिनी भोगिलोकैः <ls>V. Ratn.</ls> .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of the mother of Bibhīṣaṇa. .²8 <ls>N.</ls> assumed by Draupadī while residing at the Court of Virāta. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a river; <ls>Ś. 3. 7</ls>. .²10 (In music) A particular श्रुति.
